changeSet.author: coop
changeSet.comment: Neutralize the publicly documented upstream seed credential without deleting account data.

changeSet.author: coop
changeSet.comment: Normalize existing GM ranks before adding the database constraint.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE characters SET gm = 0 WHERE gm < 0; UPDATE characters SET gm = 6 WHERE gm > 6;

changeSet.author: coop

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'characters' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'chk_characters_gm_level'

changeSet.comment: Enforce the supported GM rank range at the database boundary.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE characters ADD CONSTRAINT chk_characters_gm_level CHECK (gm BETWEEN 0 AND 6);

changeSet.author: coop

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS AS cc JOIN information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS AS tc ON tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = cc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = cc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE cc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND tc.TABLE_NAME = 'characters' AND cc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'chk_characters_gm_level' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(cc.CHECK_CLAUSE, '`', ''), ' ', '')) = '(gmbetween0and6)' AND tc.ENFORCED = 'YES'

changeSet.comment: Verify GM constraint semantics and reserve every case variant of the admin account name.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE characters AS c JOIN accounts AS a ON a.id = c.accountid SET c.gm = 0 WHERE LOWER(a.name) = 'admin';
UPDATE accounts SET password = '$2y$12$OF6neGC9zX0S8CyKgbmdie.Mn/mWUdgjCNkqdDl2VNmZ/UraudUZ2', banned = 1, loggedin = 0, banreason = 'Reserved account name enforced by coop-1233' WHERE LOWER(name) = 'admin';
